text: checker.rs: a call whose callee names a local, param or top-level let holding a fn value of known type (let-bound user fn or lambda, fn(..)-typed param) is checked against that type like a direct call (E0305 arity, E0306 argument type); a local of unknown type no longer falls through to a top-level fn it shadows; lambda params shadow outer locals. No evaluator change, O-SF-01.
